author: eliza
source: his 2026-11-02 13:44: "yeah lets make an elite Ashta to hunt at a natural site", after my read of his May PredatorHuntTarget and vanilla's Ashta -> Alpha Ashta
_note: ELITE TEST E1: the first `elite` on a defeat. The build clones PCM_Cheyenne_Akila_Ashta as duo_delvetest_e1_b1elite with vanilla's alpha swaps (challenge VeryHard, + Special_Boss, size up one) and its own name, and does NOT retarget the template chain as his May PredatorHuntTarget did.

What his play answers: (1) does a plain clone render, at all and as an Ashta (if not, the May retarget goes back in, and we know why it existed); (2) does it read as an elite: bigger, harder, the name on its health bar; (3) does the board place a NATURAL site on Akila (no Delve has pinned a planet AND required a theme).
Silent on purpose: no speaker, broadcast or say, so no voice spend. The words are placeholders for a probe, not Jessica's; if it graduates, a real recipe gets hers. Unbuilt once it has told us.
